query:
query SearchClimbs($input: ClimbSearchInput!) {
    searchClimbs(input: $input) {
      climbs {
        
  uuid
  boardType
  layoutId
  setter_username
  userId
  name
  description
  frames
  angle
  statsAngle
  ascensionist_count
  difficulty
  quality_average
  stars
  difficulty_error
  benchmark_difficulty
  is_draft
  is_hidden
  is_no_match
  characteristics
  published_at
  created_at
  userAscents
  userAttempts
  framesCount
  framesPace
  boardseshDifficulty
  boardseshConfidence
  compatibleSizeIds

      }
      hasMore
    }
  }
